items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jimmy Pupa was on there on trumpet

ctx.x: I didn’t. Murphy:…of the other members of the band, do you remember?

Yeah, there again, my first session I think my brother Leonard played bass, Jimmy Lyons played piano, was a fairly good pianist at that time, well known. Bernie Glow played first trumpet, Jimmy Pupa was on there on trumpet. Who else was in that band? I think I had in one of my sessions I had Lee Konitz. Isn’t that funny? I can’t remember all the guys in that band.
And so you made a recording, were you also doing gigs around…
